name: end-marker-terminated
description: The end from outside TSB: when a session's worker dies — or the target closes the session, or its connection is lost — the session cannot continue, and the core finalizes its recording with a terminated end marker — sidecar code 4, no data, the time the session ended, as seen by the component that observed the end (the core at this tag) — as the last frame: immortality §1.1 and §3's 'recording is finalized with a termination marker'. The rules are end-marker-killed's. Published at e0 — self-check grades these bytes at every run — and required green at e1, when a collection must hold the recording of a session that ended terminated (the harness's worker-death rig; worker-death-recorded). At e0 the core's own test proves the terminated marker (C1 session-ended-unexpectedly).
